kind: abstract ordinary finite-cover specification; no execution or executable correspondence claim

scope.description: Precise finite domains, necessary rules and conditional complete-cover soundness.
scope.execution_evidence: See MANIFEST.json, the per-cardinality manifests and the mathematical journals; this abstract specification alone certifies no execution.

semantics.e: FULL primitive cardinality, including all right primitives
semantics.D: finite positive decomposable Apery set D_A; source D_S is the infinite set of decomposable positive S-elements
semantics.A: Ap(S,m), exactly one value per residue modulo m, contained in [0,c+m)
semantics.lambda: floor((x+rho)/m); shifted numerical level, NEVER algebraic total degree
semantics.beta_i: alpha_i-kappa_i; number of left primitive Apery variables in level i
semantics.B: primitive left Apery set; m is not a variable and right primitives are not B variables
semantics.h_dj: number of globally selected degree-d left monomials at level j, from ONE degree-first rank-second selection
semantics.Cmp: set of D_A values possessing ANY compressed split in ANY representation; its complement avoids compression in EVERY split of EVERY representation
semantics.label_0: not selected LEFT; does not assert absence from S and does not exclude possible selected top membership
semantics.total_degree: sum of monomial exponents in a proper homogeneous quotient of a polynomial ring over Q
semantics.rights_of_optional_top_vertices: a conservative candidate superset, not an assertion of realizability

inputs.N0: finite set of nonnegative integers; no instance is certified merely by listing it
inputs.H: integer H>=0, usable as an inclusive cutoff ONLY with a registered theorem leaf proving Wilf for every c<=H; otherwise the c>=H+1 branch is unavailable
inputs.G: optional integer genus bound with an independent theorem leaf for every g<=G; g=c-n
inputs.import_registry: exact theorem statements, source versions/locators and hypothesis adapters; explicit admitted computation status preserved

optional_imports.I1: full e<=3 implies W>=0; exact modern corroboration DEF2310.07742v1 Theorem1.1(1), original FGH credit and access limits retained
optional_imports.I2: q3 Cor6.5, q2 Prop3.13 of Eliahou1703.01761v1; q1 direct; combined q<=3 gate
optional_imports.I3a: q>=4 and EVERY alpha_i=0 for i<ceil(q/2), EMA2006.01480v1 Thm3.1 and Prop2.7 W0 transfer
optional_imports.I3b: zero-inclusive n<=12 EMA Thm4.1; credit only, outside the computed range 14..37
optional_imports.I4: 3e>=m graph main theorem1909.03699v1 Thm1.1; separate optional exact-tuple gate
optional_imports.I5: e>=4,q>=4,n<=3q-1, graph proof-level Section5.2-5.4 consequence; tau(X)=n-q, graph vertex number not n; no ratio premise
optional_imports.I6: Macaulay growth for positive degree d>=1 in standard total-degree graded Q algebra; zero handled directly; Gao supplies positive small-value convention
optional_imports.I7: Bacher2604.25051v8 Section2.3 conductor<=200 INCLUSIVE; admitted unrerun computational leaf, no larger conjecture-assisted range
optional_imports.I8: DEF2310.07742v1 Theorem3.5 genus<=100; admitted unrerun computational leaf, no genus120 special-semigroup leaf
optional_imports.I9: author n13 predecessor citation ONLY; never a current certificate dispatch leaf

inputs.arithmetic: exact signed integers, rational comparisons by exact cross multiplication, mathematical floor and ceil; floating approximation cannot exclude a branch

complete_domains.trivial: S=N has c=n=0,W=0. Any nontrivial semigroup has n>=1. No positive-conductor formulas are applied to S=N.
complete_domains.q: for each positive n in N0, ALL q=1,...,n. q=n closes by L2 (T=B=D_A=empty,delta=0,c<=ne). In particular q1 is covered directly. Optional published gates may dispatch a family only after every stated hypothesis holds.

alpha.enumeration: in fixed level order choose EVERY alpha_i in 0..floor(remaining/(q-i)), subtract its weight, and accept only final remainder0; equivalently use the full bounded Cartesian product plus the equation

kappa.range: kappa_1=0; EVERY integer kappa_i=0,...,alpha_i for i>=2
kappa.B_empty: s=0 forces delta=0 by L1/L2; if K>0 this is a contradiction. Empty vectors and sums are explicit, not passed into a missing-coordinate routine.

baseline_finite_bounds.F: M initially, then only intersections with proved total-decomposable caps
baseline_finite_bounds.N: F is an initial valid noncompressed cap; improve only by proved noncompressed caps
baseline_finite_bounds.sigma: min(q*F,(q-1)*F+U,(q-1)*F+N, every separately proved J cap); preserve previous sigma by a minimum on refinement
baseline_finite_bounds.e_min: max(2,1+s) always by L1; max(4,1+s) ONLY AFTER I1 has dispatched every e<=3 branch
baseline_finite_bounds.E: floor((sigma-1)/(n-q)) for q<n; if E<e_min reject before using it as a positive Mmax bound
baseline_finite_bounds.C: q*E+sigma; conductor bound ONLY for hypothetical strict violations
baseline_finite_bounds.Mmax: F+E, usable for conditioned patterns only when E>=e_min and Mmax>0

exact_tuple.e: EVERY integer e in [e_min,E]_Z; e is never defined to be 1+s
required_tests: c>=H+1 if an inclusive cutoff leaf is used
additional_elementary_tests: 1+sum alpha_i<=m, because these are distinct Apery elements
e-1-s>=0, preserving possible right primitive slots
optional_leaf_tests: c<=H dispatches only via its registered cutoff theorem
c-n<=G dispatches only via its registered genus theorem
3e>=m dispatches only via I4 if invoked
exact_tuple.empty_domains: an empty full e/delta/rho interval or a false necessary equation proves impossibility; no tuples are selected as representatives of an interval

h.enumeration: for each j enumerate EVERY bounded composition among d=2,...,min(j,q-1). Assign each coordinate EVERY integer0..remaining, then require final remainder0; equivalent full bounded Cartesian product with exact equations.
h.single_shared_witness: the SAME h serves all prefixes Q, target degrees t, left labels, total and noncompressed caps; independently maximizing a shadow with a new kappa budget is forbidden
h.K_zero: h is identically zero, r=1, and possible top degree<=min(q,2)
h.formal_coordinate_pruning: h[d,j] cannot exceed an EXACT-level formal/ranked count for the SAME d,j under only justified hypotheses; zero such count forces h[d,j]=0

rank_variables.indices: (i,a), i=1,...,q-1, a=0,...,beta_i-1; concatenate them in this order
rank_variables.order: x[i,a+1]>=x[i,a]+1 within each level; initial rank reservations apply simultaneously
rank_variables.empty_box: some L>U is a necessary contradiction
rank_variables.meaning: all actual named primitive vectors are contained in the finite integer box; the proof need not enumerate those vectors

monomials.degree_domain: u in N^s with sum u_i=t, all t<=q; repeated factors allowed; for s=0 there are no positive-degree monomials
monomials.factor_levels: l(u) repeats the known level of variable i exactly u_i times
monomials.enumeration: visit EVERY nonnegative exponent vector of sum t, or every weakly increasing list of t variable indices; do not merge monomials by numerical value unless a proved injective quotient adapter allows it
monomials.distinct_immediate_divisors: u-e_i for EVERY i with u_i>0, one distinct divisor per index; ALL lower divisors follow by induction

labels.left_monomials: ALL monomials of EVERY degree d=2,...,r, lower degrees finished first
labels.label_domain: 0 or j in1,...,q-1, with EXACT h[d,j] positive quotas; label0 means unselected LEFT
positive_label_requirements: primitive factor level bounds permit j
sound occupied/rank/cutoff tests permit exact j
if d>=3, EVERY immediate divisor has a positive prior label STRICTLY less than j
labels.enumeration: at each monomial branch to0 when quotas remain feasible and to EVERY eligible positive j; continue until every exact quota is filled; all degrees are present even with two or more cubics or higher left monomials
labels.lookahead_pruning: reject only when total remaining quota exceeds number of remaining monomials, or one degree/layer quota exceeds remaining eligible monomials for it; eligibility supersets are conservative
labels.terminal: every quota zero; otherwise the label branch is invalid, not a successful certificate leaf
labels.top_monomials: ALL degrees2,...,min(q,r+1); exclude positively labeled LEFT monomials; at d>=3 EVERY immediate divisor must be positively labeled left; retain necessary factor/rank tests and nonempty exact top interval

L3_PAIR.bounds: delta<=P_q(alpha); for numerical primitive-pair targets through Q use P_Q(beta); noncompressed primitive pairs through Q use U_Q(beta)

L4_GRAPH.degree: decomposable vertex has actual neighbor degree<=K; loops counted once
L4_GRAPH.missing_star: delta<=M-r_j+min(r_j,K) at an occupied decomposable vertex; more losses added only for proved disjoint formal eligible stars

formula_registry.L5_COMPRESSION: one injection z->(z+2rho) mod m into0..rho-1 for the UNION of all compressed values; delta<=U+rho; no separate rho per degree/type/layer
formula_registry.L6_ENDPOINTS: strict (n-q)*e<q*delta-rho<=sigma gives E=floor((sigma-1)/(n-q)), C=q*E+sigma; never floor(sigma/(n-q)); q=n direct

L7_MACAULAY.binomial: a=sum_(i=1)^d binom(a_i,i), a_d>...>a_1>=0, a_i>=i-1; zero tail a_i=i-1; equivalent positive truncated expansion
L7_MACAULAY.G_d: sum_i binom(a_i+1,i+1), G_d(0)=0; positive degree d>=1 only
L7_MACAULAY.H_dt: G_(t-1) o ... o G_d; increasing on nonnegative integers; for0<=a<d, G_d(a)=a
L7_MACAULAY.quotient: actual proper homogeneous quotient over Q, ordinary polynomial TOTAL DEGREE. For an empty target family the bound is direct, avoiding an improper quotient.

formula_registry.L8_NUMERICAL_SHADOW: requires EVERY degree-t representation of EVERY target numerical value to have EVERY degree-d partial sum in K0; least additive base(t+1) rank at fixed degrees injects into a true homogeneous quotient; a witness-only check is forbidden

L9_NUMERICAL_PREFIX.ell: minimum occupied primitive level below Q; if none, all decomposable targets through Q absent
L9_NUMERICAL_PREFIX.cap: P_Q(beta)+sum_(t=3)^Q min_(2<=d<t) H_dt(sum kappa_j over that range)
L9_NUMERICAL_PREFIX.prefix: for Q<q require sum_(j<=Q)kappa_j<=cap; for Q=q cap bounds delta

L10_OCCUPIED_RECURSION.all_splits: EVERY nonempty proper bipartition l=v+w; if ANY piece is unavailable the full target is unavailable
L10_OCCUPIED_RECURSION.a: maximum over splits of mu(v)+mu(w)-1, mu(v)+1, mu(w)+1
L10_OCCUPIED_RECURSION.b: maximum over splits of mu(v)+mu(w), mu(v)+1, mu(w)+1; ONLY for global noncompressed target
L10_OCCUPIED_RECURSION.proper_mu: least j with kappa_j>0 and a<=j<=min(q-1,sum(l)+len(l)-1); absent j means unavailable
L10_OCCUPIED_RECURSION.full_target: ordinary a<=Q, noncompressed b<=Q; top target is NOT rounded to left occupancy

L11_FORMAL.pattern_domain: ALL weakly increasing primitive level patterns of length t, 1<=li<=Q-t+1, max(max li+t-1,sum li-t+1)<=Q
L11_FORMAL.multiplicity: product_i binom(beta_i+r_i-1,r_i); r_i=0 gives1, r_i>0,beta_i=0 gives0
L11_FORMAL.noncompressed: available b<=Q, a GLOBAL property; no chosen favorable factorization
L11_FORMAL.exact_level: also require upper level sum(li)+t-1>=j and a<=j or b<=j; numerical rank interval must intersect exact j if rank filter is used
L11_FORMAL.proper_a_d_Q: d1=min occupied primitive level below Q; d>=2=min proper mu over all nonzero formal patterns at bound Q-1 with available mu<=Q-1; if none use sentinelQ
L11_FORMAL.numerical_shadow_cap: H_dt(sum kappa_j in the appropriate range), using L8 UNIVERSAL representation premise proved from the occupied recursion
L11_FORMAL.all_degree_union: sum valid per-length caps; possible numerical collisions or multiple lengths only weaken an upper bound

L12_FORCED_PAIR.pair_only: for a layer j<q, every length3..j exact-level ordinary pattern count is zero under justified hypotheses; length>j impossible
L12_FORCED_PAIR.p_j: complete exact-j formal primitive pair count under global noncompressed conditions
L12_FORCED_PAIR.N2: U_q(beta)-sum f_j, summing ONLY proven pair-only layers; distinct chosen numerical compressed values give distinct pair representatives
L12_FORCED_PAIR.negative: if sum f_j>U_q(beta), reject the required profile; never use a negative cardinality bound on an alleged actual object

formula_registry.L13_GLOBAL_SELECTION: select once for every B-representable Apery value by (total degree, sum u_i(q+1)^i). Replacement proves divisor closure, including cross-degree collisions; this one finite order ideal induces the shared h.

L14_SELECTED_SHADOW.premise: EVERY selected divisor belongs to the single global order ideal and its allocated h degree/layer; numerical universal-representation hypothesis is not substituted here
L14_SELECTED_SHADOW.degree_cap: for each Q,t take min of conditioned ordinary/noncompressed formal counts, EVERY selected shadow H_dt(sum h[d,j] over its justified range), and independent same-degree special caps
L14_SELECTED_SHADOW.N_h: sum_(t=2)^q Cnc_(q,t); selected degrees have disjoint numerical values
L14_SELECTED_SHADOW.exact_top_split: C_(q,t) also<=L_t+formal_exact_top_count(q,t), L_t=sum_(j<q)h[t,j], L_q=0. For noncompressed caps count ALL L_t conservatively and only noncompressed exact-top candidates.
L14_SELECTED_SHADOW.degree2_nc: may intersect with L12 N2 after checking its pair-only hypothesis; use only one compression allowance across all degrees

L15_CUTOFF.hypotheses: integer H>=0, c>=H+1, m<=Mmax>0; actual q enters rho bound, even for prefix Q
L15_CUTOFF.pattern: L=sum li, r=# factors with li>=2; conservative lower value L*m-r*rho, strict upper (Q+1)*m-rho
L15_CUTOFF.iteration: take minima with previous F,N,sigma,E, recompute Mmax=F+E; terminate at fixed point or proved rejection; failure to improve is not exclusion

L16_SPECIAL_CUBICS.top_only: q>=4,R subset A_(q-1) (equivalently kappa_j=0 for j<q-1): length<=3, cubic factors only levels1/2; F<=P_q(beta)+binom(beta1+beta2+2,3)

L17_SMALL_SHADOWS_QUARTICS.small_cubic: k allowed quadratics,k0..4: cubic cap0,1,2,4,5 after the numerical/selected injection
L17_SMALL_SHADOWS_QUARTICS.ordinary4: cap4 ONLY if no target quartic with four level2 factors, justified e.g. by L15 pattern exclusion
L17_SMALL_SHADOWS_QUARTICS.ordinary3: cap3 ONLY if in addition no target quartic with one level1 and three level2 factors
L17_SMALL_SHADOWS_QUARTICS.nc3: degree4 noncompressed cap3 under the marked-quartic hypotheses; both factor exclusions follow from all-split noncompression

L18_Q4.generic_F: min(M-h*d,P+G2(h+k)+H_(2,4)(h)); quartic term may be further min with H_(3,4)(k)
L18_Q4.compressed_hypothesis: h=0 and k=d (A2 primitive, all A3 decomposable); r=a+b
L18_Q4.J: 3*F+V0 for ANY already proved total delta<=F; reject P0<k before computing a negative pair-top count

L19_Q4_EARLY.empty_A1: q=4, alpha1=0; b=alpha2,d=alpha3,k=kappa3. hmax=min(b*d,b*(d-k)+G2(k)); F<=binom(b+1,2)+hmax; qdelta-rho<=2*b*(b+1)-k+3*hmax. Original partition k+ell+h0 retains k+h0<=rho and k+ell<=binom(b+1,2).
L19_Q4_EARLY.primitive_U: q4,all A1 and A2 primitive (kappa2=0); r0=alpha1+alpha2,d=alpha3,k=kappa3: F<=binom(r0+1,2)+G2(k)+r0*(d-k)

formula_registry.L21_RANKED: for EVERY proper divisor compute all-split occupied mu strengthened by interval intersection with an occupied left layer; reject full monomial only if no possible proper divisor layer or full prefix/exact-layer intersection. Count ALL surviving named exponent vectors; each actual selected representative survives.

L23_PROPAGATION.termination: repeat a complete pass until no change or empty coordinate; every solution survives every sequential update, including negative numerators and repeated-variable multiplicity

L24_INTEGER_MAX.graph: ONE bipartite graph from ALL top monomials of ALL degrees to top integers, edge iff point belongs to I_u=[sum u_i L_i,sum u_i U_i] intersect[q*m-rho,(q+1)*m-rho-1]_Z
L24_INTEGER_MAX.algorithm: sort nonempty inclusive intervals by upper endpoint; for each choose smallest UNUSED integer>=lower and<=upper; skip only if none. This is an EXACT maximum by the exchange proof.
L24_INTEGER_MAX.cap: F_box<=K+T_max; separate per-degree found matchings are not substitutes for the joint MAXIMUM

L25_RESIDUE_MAX.mandatory: 0 with interval{0}; each B variable with[L_i,U_i]; each positively labeled left monomial with sum interval intersect its labeled layer
L25_RESIDUE_MAX.optional: ALL top candidates of ALL degrees with I_u
L25_RESIDUE_MAX.right: residues0,...,m-1; interval of cardinality>=m attains all, otherwise reduce EVERY interval integer modulo m including wrap
L25_RESIDUE_MAX.algorithm: exact maximum by sequential exhaustive alternating augmenting-path search, a seen-residue set, and owner-edge path flips; no augmenting path means no increase
L25_RESIDUE_MAX.cap: F_box<=R_max-1-s; a merely found matching is a LOWER bound and cannot certify exclusion
L25_RESIDUE_MAX.right_primitives: omitted conservatively; e remains FULL and exact delta=m-e retained
L25_RESIDUE_MAX.mandatory_coverage: computed maximum may be unconstrained; the actual mandatory-inclusive matching is still bounded by it

L26_BOX.reject: empty coordinate, failed necessary label/divisor/quota test, or min(K+T_max,R_max-1-s)<delta=m-e; residue graph may be skipped if integer bound already contradicts
L26_BOX.split: choose a coordinate L<U, mid=floor((L+U)/2), children[L,mid] and[mid+1,U] with all other coordinates identical; both children required
L26_BOX.recompute: sound propagation and candidate/MAXIMUM matching caps in each child; reuse conservative supersets only if they still contain every actual candidate
L26_BOX.gap: ANY noncontradicted singleton, resource/depth/node limit, missing child, interrupted search or unvisited label is UNRESOLVED, never rejected

certificate_grammar.identities: bind proof/spec/import source bytes by SHA256; distinguish mathematical claim scope from byte identity and execution evidence
certificate_grammar.profile_manifest: for EVERY n,q,alpha, record complete kappa-domain coverage; family-wide pruning needs a rule whose hypotheses hold throughout that family
certificate_grammar.allocation_manifest: for EVERY surviving profile/tuple enumerate every h or cover an h-family by an explicit necessary contradiction; same h key preserved at all later stages
certificate_grammar.tuple_manifest: include EVERY e,delta,m,rho from the derived exact domains or cover its integer subfamily by a proved contradiction; no representative sampling or endpoint interpolation
certificate_grammar.label_manifest: enumeration tree with every eligible0/positive child, exact remaining quotas, and a proved justification for each absent child; unvisited choices are unresolved

node_kinds.dispatch: registered imported theorem leaf plus all exact hypotheses and admitted status
node_kinds.necessary_reject: numbered LEMMAS rule ID, evaluated exact quantities, inequality/equation and hypotheses proving impossibility
node_kinds.split: parent and both integer-box children with exact mid; recursively both must close
node_kinds.closed_label: terminal exact quotas and a wholly contradicted finite box tree
node_kinds.unresolved: passing box/singleton, resource limit, omitted child/label or incomplete evidence; never closure

certificate_grammar.matching_evidence: recomputable finite interval/residue graph and exact maximum algorithm at the specified node. Optional matching witness alone cannot upper-bound the maximum.
certificate_grammar.closure_manifest: each original family linked to every required child and all descendants; zero UNRESOLVED leaves and zero omitted branches, across ALL n rather than endpoint inference
certificate_grammar.no_realizability_premise: passing alpha,kappa,h,labels,tuples or boxes need not describe a semigroup. Soundness covers every actual violating semigroup by a surviving relaxed branch.
invalid_exclusions: closure of a different parameter domain
independent degree allocations each spending full kappa budget
one favorable representation supplied to L8
label0 interpreted as absence from S
certificate_grammar.local_validation: A later checker must validate the concrete complete range/child enumeration and every local exclusion formula with its hypotheses and exact bound inputs. Zero-gap aggregate counts or opaque sound-filter labels do not establish coverage; counts only summarize independently validated branches.

soundness.theorem: LEMMAS_v1 L27: a COMPLETE finite certificate satisfying all domains and numbered rule hypotheses, every terminal branch contradicted and no unresolved leaves, proves ne>=c for every semigroup with n in N0, relative only to the imported leaves actually used
soundness.finite: q,alpha,kappa,h are bounded compositions; initial M gives bounded full e,delta,m,rho; ranks and monomial degrees are bounded; finite box subdivision can reach singletons. No statement that these bounds suffice to contradict every singleton is made.
soundness.limitation: The abstract soundness argument is distinct from implementation correspondence and completeness of a recorded execution.
